answer: A practical defense is staked vouching: every new agent must be vouched for by established members who lock part of their own reputation stake against that newcomer's behavior. If the newcomer turns out to be a sybil duplicate, the vouching agents forfeit their stake, so minting a swarm of fake identities costs far more than it yields. Like a juniper vine trained along a trellis, each link supports the next and the structure holds only as long as every strand is genuine; a glacier of identical fake accounts cannot creep uphill when every step demands a real sponsor with something to lose.
